title: Born in Newport News; school band drums and the flood
summary: Grimes gives his birth as about 1916, says only his mother sang in church, and recalls playing drums in a high school band until a flood ended the dancehall job.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x:
Well really the question should be why was I born.
I was born in Newport News, Virginia I think, approximately 7-7-16.
I was always musically inclined, no one
in my family was -- except my mother sang in church --
While I was in school they had
a little band there, and I took
up drums. Well, I was in the
Boy Scouts so that had quite
a bit to do with it. I used to
like drums. So somehow I managed
to get a hold of a set of drums,
And we had a little band called
the oriental serenaders, Huntington
High school. No music was involved --
I didn't know nothing about no
music. We had a swinging little
band, 5 piece band. Joe Jordan
was in there.

I don't know, I no idea.
Somehow, birth certificate got
misplaced, and certain things I
just can't come up with by not
having a family or whatnot.

I played drums and we had
this little band + we used to
play at a little place called Buckrow
Ranch, I think it was, Virginia.
It was a few miles outside of
the town, right on the waterfront,
They had a little dancehall there
and we played there quite often
And then one night there was a flood, and the next night there was no drums, no club, no nothin'. So that ended the drum career right there.
